name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Protection & Setup
intent: Deploy ground protection, mask fixtures/utilities, set up spray or brush/roll equipment.
doctrine: Protection and setup for fiber cement siding. Same pattern as wood/engineered siding. Equipment setup at global rates: spray 12 min, brush/roll 5 min. No spray_backroll for FC — back-rolling introduces unwanted stipple on factory-smooth surface.
